title: List request (input, contract v0)
description: What agentspace lease list takes: its flags on the command line, or this document as JSON. Both filters are optional, and null means not given. An empty state array is refused, because it could mean every state or none. See docs/lease-api.md.

project.description: Only this project's leases. Letters, digits and '-', 1 to 32, in any case.

state.description: Only leases in this state, or in any of these states. State names in any case.
